findings.title: Offspring and collective formation
findings.claim: The sons noun keeps its ordinary descendant sense while the final making clause lets that lineage read as continuity assembled into a larger group.
findings.mechanism: The carrier banina belongs to the b-n-y building field; the independent jaʿalnakum-akthara-nafiran result gathers the addressed people into greater mobilized force, so offspring continuity meets the making of a collective.
findings.reader_payoff: The increase becomes generational and assembled, not only numerical.
findings.containment: The local noun still means sons or descendants. No literal buildings, fixed family size, or genealogical doctrine is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The noun and final result clause are focus-grounded; the building image is root pressure activated across roots rather than the selected lexical sense.
